newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOT-Mitsubishi debenture coupon set lower than IBJ.
newsitem.headline: BOT-Mitsubishi debenture coupon set lower than IBJ.

text.p: The Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd (BOTM) said on Tuesday it had set the coupon rate for its May five-year debenture at a level lower than that of the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd's (IBJ) debenture.
This is the first time a bank has set a coupon rate for a debenture at a level lower than that of IBJ's debenture, which is considered to be the benchmark in the market, traders said.
Currently, seven Japanese banks issue debentures.
BOTM said on Tuesday it had set the coupon rate for its May five-year debenture to be sold to institutional investors at 2.1 percent, up from 1.6 percent in the April issue.
That is compared with IBJ's May debenture coupon rate of 2.2 percent, which was raised from 1.6 percent in April.
A BOTM official said the new coupon rate was set after the bank's 1.6 percent April debenture was traded at a yield of 2.25 percent earlier on Tuesday.
On Monday, the IBJ raised the coupon rate of its May debenture to 2.2 percent after its 1.6 percent April debenture was traded at a yield of 2.3 percent on Friday.
